fact: All party members advance to 4th level.
source_quote: everyone advanced to 4th level
subject: character leveling

fact: Daz's Intelligence score increases to 19.
source_quote: Daz's Intelligence reaches 19
subject: Daz

fact: Gyrgum temporarily raises a score to 19.
source_quote: Gyrgum bumps a score to 19 "at least temporarily"
subject: Gyrgum

fact: The party has not taken a long rest since the skeleton fight.
source_quote: The party has not taken a long rest since the fight
subject: rest status

fact: Pelek is a ghost with a gruesome cleaved head.
source_quote: A ghost with a gruesome cleaved head emerged from the ground
subject: Pelek

fact: The spot where the ghost emerged is marked on the map as "Buppido's resting place".
source_quote: The spot is marked on the map as "Buppido's resting place"
subject: Buppido's resting place

fact: Pelek is a deep gnome traveler from Blingdenstone.
source_quote: Pelek, a deep gnome traveler from Blingdenstone
subject: Pelek

fact: Pelek's mother named him after an actor who appeared in Blingdenstone.
source_quote: his mother named him after an actor who showed up in Blingdenstone
subject: Pelek

fact: Buppido is a derro who was previously friends with Pelek.
source_quote: he had once been friends with a derro named Buppido
subject: Buppido

fact: Pelek was trapped in the caverns for approximately a year.
source_quote: trapped in the caverns ever since, which he reckoned was about a year
subject: Pelek

fact: Pelek attempted to possess Buppido but failed.
source_quote: he had even tried to possess Buppido, and the effort failed entirely
subject: attempted possession

fact: Gyrgum wraps Pelek's bones and stores them in his pack.
source_quote: Gyrgum wrapped them up and tucked them into his pack
subject: bone collection

fact: Pelek asks the party to carry his bones to his ancestral home in Blingdenstone.
source_quote: collect his specific bones and carry them back to Blingdenstone, where they could be buried in his ancestral home
subject: Pelek

fact: Thorin fumbles an intimidation attempt against Pelek.
source_quote: Thorin pressed the ghost on what the party got out of the deal and fumbled an intimidation attempt badly
subject: intimidation attempt

fact: Thorin rolls a 1 on his intimidation check against Pelek.
source_quote: Thorin rolls a 1
subject: intimidation rolls

fact: Pelek laughs off Thorin and Daz's intimidation attempts.
source_quote: Pelek laughs both off
subject: Pelek

fact: Pelek advises the party to claim the drow among them has no ties to Menzoberranzan at Blingdenstone gates.
source_quote: they must make absolutely clear that the drow among them had no ties to Menzoberranzan
subject: Pelek

fact: Pelek's severed hand was animated by tunnel magic and scuttled away while wearing an obsidian ring.
source_quote: strange magic pervading the tunnels had animated his severed hand, which had scuttled away... still wearing his obsidian ring
subject: obsidian ring

fact: Pelek's spirit binds to the party and travels alongside them.
source_quote: Pelek's spirit drifted alongside them as a companion, bound to wherever his remains traveled
subject: Pelek

fact: Pelek does not gain levels but acts as a companion whose thoughts are audible to the party.
source_quote: Pelek does not gain levels but is now effectively a companion whose thoughts the party hear
subject: Pelek
